design_references.prompt: Create one polished 9 by 16 portrait mobile tactical-RPG combat UI design reference for the new Whitemarch game. Show a readable hybrid 2.5D battlefield with painterly 2D adult character figures, a restrained top utility bar, a compact active-actor context and condition area, a forecast or time strip, four large tactical action controls, one unmistakable primary commit control, and one quiet event or chronicle strip. Unify every interface surface as one field-folio material family using deep slate and civic blue, warm ivory vellum, pale limewash, restrained river-blue information accents, and muted brass fastenings. Keep the battlefield visually dominant and every touch target clear at mobile scale. Ground clothing, weapons, props, and construction in Central and Northwestern Europe circa 1400-1475, but keep the setting light, hopeful high fantasy rather than grimdark. Render the complete concept in high-definition oil-brush painterly 2D anime style with visible hand-painted texture, natural materials, restrained linework, and coherent common lighting. Use native-looking blank iconography and data shapes only; no generated words, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks, pixel art, low-resolution 8-bit styling, SVG or flat-vector finish, photorealism, glossy 3D-render finish, neon sci-fi chrome, arbitrary magical glow, or crystal ornament.
